summary: Gives an applicability statement for using GMPLS protocols to support Basic Mode Layer 1 VPNs. In Basic Mode, no routing information is exchanged between the Layer 1 network and the customer. It examines how GMPLS protocols can meet the requirements. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This paper checks whether an existing set of tools is a good fit for private shared fiber links, and how to use it.
